description: InCopy assignments (Assignments panel): list them with their content and status; create an assignment file with a user name, colour and what it includes; edit its options; add text frames' stories to it (exporting them for InCopy first); delete it; write changes to selected, all or out-of-date assignment files (optionally saving the layout first so geometry changes reach InCopy users); package it for InCopy or cancel a package; or reveal its file in Finder or Explorer

content.description: For create and edit: what the assignment file includes: placeholder frames only, the assigned spreads, or every spread

frameColor.description: For create and edit: the frame colour that marks its content: a colour name such as "red" or "light_blue", or "#RRGGBB"

frameIds.description: For create and add_content: text frames whose stories to add

includeLinksWhenPackage.description: For create and edit: include linked image files in packages

name.description: The assignment name (for create, the new name)

names.description: For update with which named: the assignments

path.description: For create: the assignment file (.icma); for package: the package file (.icap)

saveDocument.description: For update: save the document first, so layout changes reach InCopy users

submit.description: For package: check in (submit) the assigned content before packaging

userName.description: For create and edit: the InCopy user it is assigned to

which.description: For update: the named assignments (names), all, or the out-of-date ones

name: manage_assignments
title: Manage Assignments
